run.method: headless Chrome via _local/competitive/round3/verify/shot.mjs (one or two loads per page; per-shot JSON beside each PNG holds URL, final URL, HTTP status, load time, driver result); static HTML via curl; official sources via WebFetch/WebSearch and the Skatteverket open-data API
run.network_note: local DNS filter blocks some ad/analytics hosts (see objective/findings.md); no effect on the figures checked here
run.consent: cookie banners declined where a decline button existed (ekonomifokus 'Avvisa alla', Swedbank 'Bara nödvändiga cookies', Konsumenternas and helhetskollen 'Endast nödvändiga'). borskollen offers no decline button: its UniConsent overlay (#uniccmp) was hidden with CSS for the screenshot, no consent given.

claims.claim: ISK article: about 5 000 kr tax on 500 000 kr, old schablon rate about 3.3%, no 300 000 kr tax-free amount
quote: On a 500,000 SEK account, that's about 5,000 SEK in tax for the year, whether your investments gained 15% or lost 15%.
The statslåneränta (Swedish government borrowing rate) as of November 2025 was 2.33%. Add 1 percentage point: 2.33% + 1% = 3.33%.
claims.language_note: the article is in English; quotes are as written
claims.tax_free_amount: not mentioned: no '300', 'fribelopp', 'tax-free amount' or 'exempt' in the article text (the only 'tax-free' hits are the myth section 'Is ISK "Tax-Free"?')
claims.change: 5 000 kr and the missing 300 000 kr tax-free amount are exact. The rate is 3.33%, but it is not an old official rate: the article misstates the 30 Nov 2025 statslåneränta as 2.33% (official 2.55%). No year used 3.33% (2024: 3.62%, 2025: 2.96%). Describe it as a wrong rate, not an old one.
claims.official: 2026: 300 000 kr tax-free, schablonintäkt 3.55% (statslåneränta 2.55% at 30 Nov 2025 + 1), tax 30%: (500 000 - 300 000) x 3.55% x 30% = 2 130 kr
claims.official_source: Skatteverket, https://www.skatteverket.se/investeringssparkonto: 'Den 30 november 2025 var statslåneräntan 2,55 procent. Det betyder att schablonintäkten för inkomståret 2026 blir 3,55 procent'; 'Från och med 1 januari 2026 höjs den skattefria grundnivån till 300 000 kronor.'
claims.also: the same '5,000 SEK/year on a 500,000 SEK account' line is on the smartly.se home page article card

claims.claim: a salary link on the home page returns 404
claims.found: Every salary link on the Swedish home page points to https://statsskuld.se/berakna-nettolon (5 occurrences in the HTML, HTTP 200). Salary-related links checked in the browser: /lonestatistik, /berakna-nettolon, /berakna-bruttolon, /privatekonomi, /jamforelser/ekonomi, /lon-skatt, all 200. All 57 unique statsskuld.se hrefs in the home page HTML were status-checked: the only 404 is /kommun-data ('Kommun data'), which sits inside an HTML comment (not rendered) and is not a salary link. The English home page (/en/) links /en/berakna-nettolon.

claims.claim: 45 000 kr, Stockholm shows 35 206 kr and always deducts a church fee (about 449 kr) with no way to turn it off
claims.inputs: Bruttolön 45000; Kommun 'STOCKHOLM - STOCKHOLMS DOMKYRKOFÖRSAMLING'; checkbox 'Medlem i svenska kyrkan' (id church): left checked (default), then unchecked

output.church_on_default: Du får behålla 35,206 kr efter skatt; Kyrkoavgift 449 kr; Summa skatter & avgifter 9,794 kr
output.church_off: Du får behålla 35,655 kr efter skatt; Kyrkoavgift 0 kr; Summa skatter & avgifter 9,345 kr

claims.what_is_true: 35 206 kr with a 449 kr church fee is the default result, because the church box is ticked by default.
claims.what_is_false: there is a 'Medlem i svenska kyrkan' checkbox and unticking it removes the fee. The earlier run (390 px phone width) reported no toggle: the real input is 0 x 0 px with opacity 0 behind a styled label, which a visible-inputs scan misses. So probably a measurement miss, not a site change; not provable either way.
claims.official: with church off, 35 655 kr is +105 kr vs table 31 (35 550) and -155 kr vs final tax (35 810)

claims.claim: home-sale page says uppskov costs about 0.5% a year
claims.page_dated: dateModified 2026-06-30T08:37 (datePublished 2023-06-28); this is the 'dated 30 June 2026' page. /reavinstkalkylator returns 404.
claims.quote: 0,5% på uppskovsbeloppet per år är kostnaden för att ha ett uppskov. Dvs om du gör en vinst på 1 miljon kr som du skjuter upp så kostar den 5000 kr/år i uppskovskostnad.
claims.change: The text is on the page and visible, but only in the reader-comment section (317 comments), as a staff reply signed 'Andreas på Ekonomifokus.se' / 'Mvh admin på Ekonomifokus', shown as '8 år sedan' (about 2018), when it was true. Similar staff replies on the same page: 'Den vinst ni skjuter med er kostar 0,5% (på vinsten) i ränta till skatteverket varje år' and '0,5% på den totala vinst som man skjuter med sig' (9 år sedan). The article body does not state a cost, and ekonomifokus's own uppskov article (dateModified 2026-10-06) says 'Det är gratis att göra uppskov ... borttagen sedan 2021-01-01' (c6c). Fair wording: old staff answers still shown under the article, not the article text.
claims.official: the schablonintäkt on uppskov was abolished from income year 2021; uppskov is interest-free
claims.official_source: regeringen.se, 'Avskaffad schablonintäkt på uppskovsbelopp' (https://www.regeringen.se/contentassets/4ac543f54a804ed9a841bc25178779e9/avskaffad-schablonintakt-pa-uppskovsbelopp.pdf); Skatteverket 'Slutligt uppskov' mentions no annual cost (https://www.skatteverket.se/privat/fastigheterochbostad/forsaljningavbostad/uppskov/slutligtuppskov.4.5c281c7015abecc2e2018bd.html)

claims.claim: home-sale page says the uppskov cap is removed
claims.quote: Hej Jonte. Taket för uppskov är borttaget så du kan nuförtiden skjuta med dig hela din vinst beroende på hur dyrt ert nya hus är.
claims.change: Again a staff reply in the comments ('Andreas på Ekonomifokus.se', '9 år sedan', about 2017). The cap was in fact suspended for sales from mid-2016 to mid-2020, so the reply was true when written and is outdated now. The article body does not say this; the uppskov article states 'taket för uppskov är 3 miljoner kr per såld bostad'.
claims.official_source: Skatteverket, Slutligt uppskov: 'Takbeloppet är 3 000 000 kronor och ditt slutliga uppskov får inte överstiga din andel av takbeloppet.'
